na2b764e67d.headline: Summit Therapeutics Shares (SMMT) Drop Overnight As New Bear Emerges - The Bull
na2b764e67d.summary: Summit Therapeutics shares fell 5.5% to $16.51 in after-hours trading after Bernstein initiated coverage, warning that its late-stage pipeline faces significant risk of failure.
na2b764e67d.why: Summit Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech whose valuation depends heavily on the success of its late-stage drug pipeline, so analyst views on that pipeline move the stock.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

sources.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

n41ab850c38.headline: KCSA explains fare hikes: expenses rise, passenger traffic drops
n41ab850c38.summary: The Kyiv City State Administration says new public transport fares reflect higher energy and fuel costs, rolling stock repairs and competitive wages, alongside a drop in passenger traffic.
n41ab850c38.why: Public transport fares are set by city authorities to cover operating costs, and fare changes affect urban mobility and municipal budgets.

n6fd5c900b0.headline: High risk that bill on taxing parcels under EUR 150 will fail – Marchenko
n6fd5c900b0.summary: The bill to cancel the duty-free import allowance for international parcels valued up to EUR 150 faces a high risk of failure, according to Marchenko. The measure concerns Ukraine's parcel import rules.
n6fd5c900b0.why: Duty-free thresholds for small parcels affect e-commerce import costs and government customs revenue. Changes to these rules shape cross-border online retail.

na2ef5d8475.headline: Alphabetti spaghetti and Australia’s international education policy problem
na2ef5d8475.summary: Neil Fitzroy explores how a growing maze of acronyms, restrictions and visa uncertainty may be undermining Australia's appeal as a study destination. International students are a significant export income source.
na2ef5d8475.why: International education is a major services export for Australia, bringing tuition and living spending into the economy. Visa settings directly affect student numbers and university revenue.

nbbcf8de153.headline: Nicosia hosts informal Ecofin meeting under Cyprus EU presidency
nbbcf8de153.summary: Finance ministers from across the European Union are meeting in Nicosia on Friday and Saturday for an informal Economic and Financial Affairs Council meeting chaired by Makis Keravnos.
nbbcf8de153.why: Ecofin sets EU fiscal and financial policy, which shapes government bond markets and the regulatory environment for banks.

nadbd0de45f.headline: Target Shares Rally on Earnings Beat as Analysts Lift Price Targets - The Bull
nadbd0de45f.summary: Target shares were at $126.15 after a 3.12% gain, extending a post-earnings rally as Wall Street analysts raised price targets. The stock is up 25% this year.
nadbd0de45f.why: Target is a large US general merchandise retailer, and its results are read as a barometer of US consumer spending.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

n3a95d0c6b5.headline: SMALL CAP MOVERS: Blue-chips bask while small-caps sulk
n3a95d0c6b5.summary: The FTSE 100 decisively regained ground lost in the early May sell-off, while the small-cap index continued to show a risk-off attitude. Blue chips outperformed small caps.
n3a95d0c6b5.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of London's largest listed companies, while small-cap indexes track smaller UK firms that are more sensitive to domestic economic conditions.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: The FTSE 100 regained ground lost in the early May sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nec4d901fb6.headline: Ukraine Invasion Day 1,548: Attacks on oil infrastructure will continue to strain RU revenues
nec4d901fb6.summary: Russian forces continued missile and long-range drone strikes against Ukraine overnight on May 20 to 21. The article says attacks on oil infrastructure will continue to strain Russian revenues.
nec4d901fb6.why: Russia's oil and gas export revenues fund a large share of its state budget, so disruptions to its energy infrastructure affect global energy supply and Russian fiscal capacity.

n724386486f.headline: 'Huge questions' over tax rebates for gas exploration
n724386486f.summary: Millions of dollars in federal tax rebates are going to gas exploration despite dubious eligibility under a scheme reserved for other purposes, according to the report.
n724386486f.why: Tax incentives for fossil fuel exploration affect government spending and the economics of gas projects in Australia, a major LNG exporter.

n4bd43b9200.headline: Taco 'bout a bad time: Aussie chain ditches US ambition
n4bd43b9200.summary: Shares in Australian-born Mexican fast-food chain Guzman y Gomez have surged after it abandoned its plan to enter the competitive US market. The company is based in Sydney.
n4bd43b9200.why: Guzman y Gomez is an ASX-listed restaurant chain, and its growth strategy affects investor expectations for the company.

n6e285fbceb.headline: 'Completely unrealistic' cuts trouble health groups, as treasurer searches for $700 million in savings
n6e285fbceb.summary: Health groups fear hundreds of millions of dollars in cuts expected from the Health Department under Treasurer Eric Abetz's state budget efficiencies program. The treasurer is searching for $700 million in savings.
n6e285fbceb.why: State budget savings programs affect public spending, service delivery and the government's fiscal position in Australian states.

nf805f17f63.headline: The aftermath of Trump-Xi summit: comparing U.S. and China announcements
nf805f17f63.summary: Analysts say the U.S. and Chinese readouts of the Trump-Xi summit show minor inconsistencies on agriculture, tariffs and rare earths, though experts argue the differences are not significant.
nf805f17f63.why: Washington and Beijing set the terms of US-China trade, tariffs and critical-mineral supply chains, which affect global manufacturers and investors.

n3758af73e7.headline: AAA data: Gas is up 43% from last Memorial Day
n3758af73e7.summary: AAA data show gas prices averaging $4.55 a gallon nationwide, up 43% from last Memorial Day, as 39.1 million travelers hit the roads.
n3758af73e7.why: Fuel prices feed directly into US consumer spending and headline inflation, which shapes Federal Reserve policy expectations.

n87571a0283.headline: Rubio says ‘slight progress’ made in ongoing Iran-US negotiations
n87571a0283.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said slight progress has been made in ongoing Iran-US negotiations. The report also says Iran may be planning missile and drone attacks on Gulf states and Israel.
n87571a0283.why: Negotiations between Iran and the US shape the risk of conflict in the Gulf, which affects oil supply and regional security.

n37bf506841.headline: US missile stocks depleted in defence of Israel, says report
n37bf506841.summary: According to The Washington Post, a large portion of US defensive and offensive capabilities were depleted during the war with Iran, particularly in defending Israel.
n37bf506841.why: Stockpile depletion can drive higher defence spending and procurement, which matters for defence contractors and the broader US budget.

n8e6eb4ad68.headline: Maharashtra’s economy to surpass those of Singapore, UAE in 2 to 3 years: Fadnavis
n8e6eb4ad68.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said the state will surpass the economies of Singapore and the UAE in two to three years. Growth is expected to be driven by innovation, artificial intelligence, startups and infrastructure.
n8e6eb4ad68.why: Maharashtra, home to Mumbai, is India's most industrialised state and a major centre of finance and business, so its growth outlook matters for investors in Indian markets.

n2c417441b2.headline: RBI announces record Rs 2.87 lakh crore dividend payout to Centre, surplus transfer rises again
n2c417441b2.summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced a record dividend payout of Rs 2.87 lakh crore to the government for FY26, adding fiscal space amid global and geopolitical challenges.
n2c417441b2.why: The RBI's surplus transfers to the government affect India's fiscal deficit and the government's borrowing needs.

n51cc138745.headline: Expected Completion Date Announced for Major Motorway
n51cc138745.summary: The government has accelerated work on the long-delayed Hyderabad-Sukkur Motorway, with three northern sections of the M-6 project expected to be completed on a set timeline. The input does not specify the date.
n51cc138745.why: Motorway projects are major infrastructure investments that can improve freight logistics and regional economic activity. Delays often raise project costs.

nd95adc68b0.headline: Ringgit ends three-day rally against US dollar amid geopolitical concerns
nd95adc68b0.summary: The ringgit retreated against the US dollar on Friday, ending a three-day winning streak. Investors focused on geopolitical tensions and hawkish stances by central banks globally.
nd95adc68b0.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar reflect global risk sentiment and central bank policy expectations.

neab9278ca3.headline: Pakistani LPG Company Plans $20 Million PSX IPO
neab9278ca3.summary: Mecom Gas Pvt Ltd is considering a US$20 million initial public offering on the Pakistan Stock Exchange as it looks to expand LPG storage capacity.
neab9278ca3.why: An IPO lets a private company raise capital from public investors, and this one would list an LPG distributor on Pakistan's main exchange.

n3d2e7c4acb.headline: Juices, Non-Alcoholic Drinks May Get More Expensive in Pakistan Soon
n3d2e7c4acb.summary: Pakistan Customs has revised customs values for imported branded fruit juices and non-alcoholic beverages for the first time in more than 13 years. Prices of these products may rise.
n3d2e7c4acb.why: Customs valuations set the base for import duties and taxes, so changes feed directly into consumer prices and importers' costs.

n7a046d27d6.headline: Coupang Eats' free delivery promotion fuels dominance concerns
n7a046d27d6.summary: Coupang Eats' decision to temporarily extend free delivery to non-paying users has drawn pushback, with critics warning that small merchants will be harmed.
n7a046d27d6.why: Coupang is a major South Korean e-commerce and food delivery platform, and its pricing decisions draw regulatory scrutiny.

n99e717e440.headline: Toshiba Starts Shipping Test Samples of 1200V Trench-Gate SiC MOSFET that will Enhance Efficiency in Next-Generation AI Data Centers
n99e717e440.summary: Toshiba has started shipping test samples of its 1200V trench-gate SiC MOSFET, the TW007D120E, designed to improve efficiency in next-generation AI data centres.
n99e717e440.why: Silicon carbide power chips improve energy efficiency in power conversion, a growing concern as AI data centres consume more electricity.

n95dfce3d5d.headline: Wheat Production Target Reduced Amid Climate Pressure
n95dfce3d5d.summary: Pakistan's federal government has officially lowered its wheat production target for the current year, after adverse weather and climate challenges hurt crop yields.
n95dfce3d5d.why: Wheat is a staple food crop, and domestic output shortfalls can increase import needs and affect food prices and inflation.

nd0d34655ec.headline: IMF Wants Pakistan to Find Perfect Excuse for Rs. 700 Billion New Tax in FY27 Budget
nd0d34655ec.summary: Pakistan needs to raise more than Rs700 billion in additional revenue and continue fiscal tightening to meet FY2026-27 budget targets, according to the IMF's requirements.
nd0d34655ec.why: The IMF's lending conditions shape Pakistan's budget, tax policy and fiscal discipline, which influence inflation, debt and investor confidence.

n983cc45e87.headline: Parliament Warns Over Fuel Levy Reliance
n983cc45e87.summary: A parliamentary caucus criticised the government's growing reliance on the petroleum levy as a main revenue measure. Lawmakers warned it is deepening inflationary pressure and the economic burden on the public.
n983cc45e87.why: The petroleum levy is a tax on fuel that feeds directly into pump prices, so changes in its use affect inflation, consumer spending and fiscal policy.

n2fe77097fb.headline: China does not make tech firms reject foreign investment, NDRC says
n2fe77097fb.summary: China's top state planner said the government has never required technology companies to reject foreign investment. It responded to a media question on whether Beijing would ask firms to do so.
n2fe77097fb.why: The National Development and Reform Commission sets economic policy and approvals in China, so its stance affects foreign investors in Chinese technology firms.

n9eda19f37a.headline: Rubio Reports Progress in Iran Talks Amid Ceasefire
n9eda19f37a.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio reported slight progress in talks to end the Iran conflict and urged the UN to act against Iran's actions. The US has paused military operations to focus on diplomacy.
n9eda19f37a.why: Diplomacy over the Iran conflict affects Middle East security, oil supply risk and the risk premium investors assign to energy and regional assets.

nf870d70ee6.headline: Over P1 per liter hike in pump prices seen
nf870d70ee6.summary: An upward adjustment of at least P1 per liter is expected at Philippine pumps next week. The report links the increase to ongoing global supply disruptions pushing prices higher.
nf870d70ee6.why: Pump prices reflect global crude and refined product costs, which feed through to transport costs, inflation and consumer spending.

n788947f2eb.headline: Developers of projects with safety issues or defects may be barred from buying land, selling homes
n788947f2eb.summary: Property developers who deliver defective homes could face penalties, including bans on land purchases and home sales of up to five years. The Straits Times reported the new penalties.
n788947f2eb.why: Stricter rules on developers affect project financing, construction timelines, and the operations of listed property companies.

n19fe70882d.headline: Shein buys Everlane, which sold millennials the dream of ethical, affordable luxury
n19fe70882d.summary: Shein has acquired Everlane, a brand whose finances have faltered in recent years. Analysts question whether the merger will alienate Everlane's existing shoppers.
n19fe70882d.why: Shein is a global fast-fashion online retailer, and acquisitions like this are a way to add brands and customers.

ned53bf138f.headline: Trump: I expect Kevin Warsh to go down as one of the very best Fed Chairman.
ned53bf138f.summary: Kevin Warsh has been sworn in as the new Federal Reserve chair, and President Trump said he expects Warsh to be one of the best Fed chairmen. The Fed sets US interest rate policy.
ned53bf138f.why: The Federal Reserve chair leads US monetary policy, which sets short-term interest rates and influences global asset prices.

n2a3f9ee18a.headline: Rubio Reports Progress in Iran Talks Amid Ceasefire
n2a3f9ee18a.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio reported slight progress in talks to end the Iran conflict and urged the UN to act. The U.S. paused military operations to focus on diplomacy.
n2a3f9ee18a.why: Middle East conflict and diplomacy affect oil supply risk, shipping routes, and risk sentiment in global markets.

n37af01a2aa.headline: wingtech-nexperia-china-court-dutch-semiconductor-lawsuit
n37af01a2aa.summary: Wingtech is seeking 8 billion yuan in damages from Nexperia after the Dutch government seized control of the chipmaker. The claim invokes China's Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law.
n37af01a2aa.why: Nexperia makes chips used in autos and electronics, and its ownership dispute between Dutch and Chinese authorities affects global semiconductor supply chains.
